title: Thus I Sing of My Hills (Kumta Nga Rwai)
cultural_context: The titular bardic poem and song from H. O. Mawrie's celebrated 1976 collection 'Kumta Nga Rwai', giving voice to the soul of the Khasi mountains.
lyrics_khasi:
Kumta nga rwai ia ki lum,
Kumta nga rwai ia ki wah,
Ia ka lyer ba pyrsad
Ha dohnud ba khlem jrah;
Nga kynud ka jingieit
Ia ka ri ba nga kha,
Ba la pynshong u Blei
Ha ka jingkmen ba sah.

Wat la ki khlur ki sep,
Wat la ka miet ka dum,
Ka sur jong ka jingshisha
Kan tyngshain ha u lum;
Rwai, ko mynsiem jong nga,
Khlem da tieng ne shepteng,
Ia ka hok jong u Khasi
Ba la buh ha ka bneng.
lyrics_english:
Thus I sing unto the mountains,
Thus I sing unto the rushing waters,
Unto the mountain wind breathing
Into my tranquil heart;
I chant my profound devotion
Unto the land of my birth,
Established by God Almighty
In everlasting peace.

Though the bright stars may set,
Though the night grows dark,
The melody of truth
Shall radiate across the peaks;
Sing on, O soul within me,
Without dread or hesitation,
Proclaiming the righteousness of the Khasi
Decreed forever in the heavens.
